caveats: Window ends 2 days before the run: FMCSA filings post 1-3 days late.
Renewals and policy swaps inside the same insurer group are not counted as gains or losses.
Insurers are rolled up by group (e.g. Progressive files under 8+ company names); 'filed_as' lists the raw names.
Gains include brand-new trucking companies' first policy ('of_which_new_carriers'); the rest were won from another insurer group.
State = the trucking company's registered address with FMCSA, not where it operates.
BMC-91X liability filings only (for-hire interstate carriers); intrastate-only fleets are not in this data.
